ddl:
CREATE TABLE Farm (
    Address VARCHAR(255),
    Contact_information VARCHAR(255),
    Farm_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Owner_name VARCHAR(255),
    Owner_type VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Crop (
    Crop_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Crop_name VARCHAR(255),
    Growth_cycle INTEGER,
    Suitable_climate_conditions VARCHAR(255),
    Suitable_soil_type VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Plot (
    Area VARCHAR(255),
    Current_status VARCHAR(255),
    Farm_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Plot_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Soil_type VARCHAR(255),
    FOREIGN KEY (Farm_ID) REFERENCES Farm(Farm_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Planting_record (
    Crop_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Expected_harvest_time DATETIME,
    Operator VARCHAR(255),
    Planting_quantity INTEGER,
    Planting_time DATETIME,
    Plot_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Plot_ID, Crop_ID, Planting_time),
    FOREIGN KEY (Crop_ID) REFERENCES Crop(Crop_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Plot_ID) REFERENCES Plot(Plot_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Harvest_record (
    Crop_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Harvest_quantity INTEGER,
    Harvest_time DATETIME,
    Operator VARCHAR(255),
    Plot_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Plot_ID, Crop_ID, Harvest_time),
    FOREIGN KEY (Crop_ID) REFERENCES Crop(Crop_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Plot_ID) REFERENCES Plot(Plot_ID)
);
gold_question: Business requirements description for a Farmland Management Information System: The system needs to manage multiple farms, with each farm recording farm ID, farm owner name, owner type (company or individual), owner contact information, and address. Each farm can have multiple plots of land. Each plot has a plot ID, area, soil type, crops, and current status (such as "sowing", "growing", "harvesting", etc.). Each crop has an ID, name, growth cycle, suitable soil type, and suitable climate conditions. For each planting operation, the system needs to record plot ID, crop, planting time, expected harvest time, planting quantity, and operator. For each harvesting operation, the system needs to record plot ID, crop, harvest time, harvest quantity, and operator.
